patch_description: The current implementation runs a single random greedy pass. Two improvements: (1) run many random restarts of the sampled greedy (each with different random decisions) and keep the best schedule found, since greedy is stochastic and variance across restarts is high; (2) apply a 2-opt style local search afterward — try moving each transaction to a different position (insertion neighborhood) and accept improvements — to fix greedy's ordering mistakes. Evaluating candidates with `get_opt_seq_cost` keeps decisions tied to actual makespan, not heuristics.
